definitions.explanation: An inner urge to resist or defy authority, rules, or those above oneself. Often used of adolescents toward parents and teachers.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{反抗心|はんこうしん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧。
examples.english: He has a strong rebellious streak.

examples.japanese: ⟦{厳|きび}しく→厳しい：01125_kibishii⟧⟦{叱|しか}る→叱る：01202_shikaru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{反抗心|はんこうしん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{抱|いだ}く→抱く：02010_idaku⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Scolding harshly can sometimes breed defiance.

examples.japanese: ⟦{思春期|ししゅんき}→思春期：12667_shishunki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{親|おや}→親：01357_oya⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{対|たい}する→対する：02126_taisuru⟧{反抗心|はんこうしん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{芽生|めば}える→芽生える：04594_mebaeru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: In adolescence, a spirit of defiance toward one's parents often begins to take root.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{反抗|はんこう}→反抗：03568_hankou⟧ (resistance, rebellion) + {心|しん} (mind, spirit). Describes an internal feeling, so it pairs with verbs of holding or arising rather than acting.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {反抗心|はんこうしん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧: to have a strong rebellious streak
- {反抗心|はんこうしん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{抱|いだ}く→抱く：02010_idaku⟧: to harbor defiance
- {反抗心|はんこうしん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{芽生|めば}える→芽生える：04594_mebaeru⟧: defiance begins to grow

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{反抗期|はんこうき}→反抗期：15877_hankouki⟧: rebellious phase — the developmental period, not the feeling itself
- ⟦{反発|はんぱつ}→反発：08676_hanpatsu⟧: opposition; pushback — an outward reaction against something, often momentary
